title: Deploy Prospectus automatically when main changes
description:
Feature: Prospectus deploys itself when main changes
  Scenario: A merge reaches production through the Amplify app
    Given Prospectus is a public repository with CI on GitHub Actions
    When a change merges to main
    Then the Amplify app d15sc1sptohtqb builds main and deploys the backend and frontend without anyone starting a build by hand

History 2026-10-18: PR 31 turned auto-build on in the repo settings. Builds 21 to 24 then failed because the intake stack declared the existing log group /aws/lambda/prospectus-intake-evaluation as a new resource (PR 32 references it instead). Job 25 failed because the account cannot reserve Lambda concurrency (PR 33 removes reservedConcurrentExecutions; API stage throttling stays). The backend stack was still in UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE at the time of writing. Cloud threads have no AWS access, so build results come from the Mac thread.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: 2026-10-18 Resolved. Auto-build on main works: after PR 32 (log group) and PR 33 (reserved concurrency) the backend stack deployed (job 26, then build 28 for ec0502a, UPDATE_COMPLETE). Closing.
